fusions.name: Shot Pattern
fusions.desc: Looses 5 arrows at once in a tight fan, each dealing 6 damage and knocking its target back 2 tiles.

fusions.name: Blasting Cap
fusions.desc: Fires a powder-packed arrow that deals 30 fire damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3 tiles for 80% of that.

fusions.name: Reload
fusions.desc: Clears the cooldown on one of your other abilities, chosen at random from those still waiting. Your movement speed rises 15% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Second Report
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, a spark leaps to the nearest enemy within 7 tiles and deals 6 lightning damage. Once every 5 seconds.
